1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line height and spacing in headings and body text.

2.why: Instruction text is sentence case with no italics or all-caps, though the otpauth provisioning URI and the log panel appear as dense text blocks (not instructions).

3.why: Every screenshot shows a single narrow column with large inputs and buttons that fits a phone-width viewport.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Set up extra protection before authorising larger payments' are one or two short plain sentences, though the label 'Provisioning value' is jargon.

5.why: Format examples appear as placeholders, e.g. '+44 7700 900000' for the mobile number and 'ABCD-EFGH-JKLM' for the recovery code.

6.why: No step requires reading more than two short sentences; the long otpauth URI is optional reference material, not required reading.

7.why: No copy buttons are shown; the user is told to 'Enter this key manually' and recovery codes sit in static display boxes with no copy affordance.

8.why: No QR code is visible on any screen despite the phrase 'if scanning is not convenient'; only a manual setup key and a text otpauth URI are offered.

9.why: Standard email and password inputs are used and the password is masked, but autofill or password-manager support cannot be confirmed from the screenshots.

10.why: Each screen has a bold step heading ('Confirm it is you', 'Set up your authenticator') and one large blue primary button ('Sign in securely', 'Verify authenticator').

11.why: Each enrolment step asks for a single action, but the MFA settings page presents Regenerate, Redeem and Sign out actions together.

12.why: Post-action feedback is explicit: 'Authenticator enabled', 'Recovery codes remaining: 8', and 'Recovery code accepted and permanently used.'

13.why: Retry is permitted ('Please try again') and recovery codes can be regenerated, but there are no reveal/hide toggles and no 'resend confirmation code' option on the identity-check screen.

14.why: The only observed error, 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.', is non-blaming and suggests retrying but never states what the actual problem is.

15.why: No reading time limit is visible, but the logs show the OTP is valid only for the 'current 30-second period', so code entry is time-limited with no indicated grace window.
